status: Evidence verdicts for review; not business approval

rows.verdict:
Supported: imports are material.
Sustained future volumes remain a forecast case; the matched balance is open.
rows.evidence:
Diesel drives imports; sales reports conflict
2024 net petrol/diesel imports: 13.078 bn L. Production, stocks, sales coverage and port allocation remain open.

rows.verdict:
Supported: concentrated demand.
Focus on Gauteng/KZN; sales totals do not establish accessible customers.
rows.evidence:
Demand sits around Vopak’s footprint
GP, KZN and WC account for 68.6% of 2022 sales. Historical volumes were broadly steady; later provinces are estimates.

rows.verdict:
Partly supported: diesel generation has fallen.
Baseline, ample and tight worlds still need sourced assumptions and tested fuel/customer-volume effects.
rows.evidence:
Demand drivers differ; L/M/H cases cover all key levers
Power, freight, fleet, prices, supply and customer access need explicit assumptions; fuel effects remain uncalibrated.

rows.verdict:
Supported: refining capacity fell.
Plant futures are conditional; capacity alone does not determine imports.
rows.evidence:
Supply change makes import needs conditional
Capacity has declined; redevelopment is conditional. Secunda/Natref product output and future cases remain open.

rows.verdict:
Open: gateway competition.
No route winner without comparable cost, service and customer access.
rows.evidence:
Alternative gateways challenge the same inland market
Matola and Walvis Bay have storage; their competitiveness depends on full costs, route capacity and access.

rows.verdict:
Footprint established; customer share unquantified.
Validate cost, service, rights and unique deliveries.
rows.evidence:
Footprint ? reach ? estimated handling
Define regions, screen customers and compare annual demand with handling at two turns/month.

rows.verdict:
Conditional: secure customer flows first.
Use existing assets; validate a capacity gap, then test investment.
rows.evidence:
Working stock ? outlook ? delivery gates
The 5.5 bn L/year example needs 211,000 m? at 14 days; test usable spare space before adding tanks.
